name: testflow
//engines: 22.12 is a hard floor, not a preference. firebase-admin/auth eagerly requires jwks-rsa, which does a top-level require('jose') — and jose@6 is pure ESM. require() of an ESM package only works on Node >=20.19 or >=22.12 (hence jwks-rsa's own engines: ^20.19.0 || ^22.12.0 || >=23). On anything older it throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM while the API route MODULE IS EVALUATED, so no handler runs, the JSON envelope never happens, and Next serves its HTML 500 page — while /api/health, which never imports the auth helper, keeps working. firebase-admin@14 also requires >=22 on its own. Deploy targets read this field to choose the runtime; without it a host is free to pick a Node that cannot load this dependency tree.
